# PROMPT 08
# INTEGRATE COMPLETE CHARACTER ANIMATION SYSTEM

Version: 1.0

Status: Integration

Priority: CRITICAL

Depends On:

- 03-validate-carry.md (APPROVED)
- 05-validate-sword.md (APPROVED)
- 07-validate-attack.md (APPROVED)

---

# PURPOSE

Integrate all approved animation families into the production game.

This prompt exists to:

- replace temporary implementations
- eliminate static placeholders
- connect all animation families to gameplay systems
- validate persistence and runtime stability

This prompt creates no art.

This prompt integrates approved art.

---

# INTEGRATION PHILOSOPHY

The official atlas remains the source of truth.

The approved animation families become extensions of the official atlas.

The purpose is not to change the character.

The purpose is not to change gameplay.

The purpose is to replace temporary visual implementations.

---

# REQUIRED INPUTS

Approved Deliverables:

carry-approved.json

sword-approved.json

attack-approved.json

---

# BLOCKING RULE

If any approval document is missing:

STOP.

Do not integrate.

Do not continue.

Resolve missing approvals first.

---

# TARGET STATE MACHINE

The final character state machine must contain:

STATE_NORMAL

STATE_CARRY

STATE_SWORD

STATE_ATTACK

---

# REQUIRED ANIMATION FAMILIES

NORMAL

- idle
- run
- jump
- fall

---

CARRY

- carry_idle
- carry_run
- carry_jump
- carry_fall

---

SWORD

- sword_idle
- sword_run
- sword_jump
- sword_fall

---

ATTACK

- attack_right
- attack_left
- attack_up
- attack_down

---

# REQUIRED STATE TRANSITIONS

## NORMAL → CARRY

Trigger:

pick object

Expected Result:

carry state activates

carry animation activates

movement remains animated

---

## CARRY → NORMAL

Trigger:

drop object

Expected Result:

normal state restored

---

## NORMAL → SWORD

Trigger:

equip sword

Expected Result:

sword state activates

movement remains animated

---

## SWORD → NORMAL

Trigger:

unequip sword

Expected Result:

normal state restored

---

## SWORD → ATTACK

Trigger:

attack input

Expected Result:

directional attack executed

attack animation completes

return to sword state

---

# FORBIDDEN IMPLEMENTATIONS

Do NOT:

- keep carry placeholders
- keep sword placeholders
- keep temporary attacks
- keep procedural attack arms
- keep fallback static poses

All temporary solutions must be removed.

---

# REQUIRED CARRY MAPPING

Gameplay Carry States must map to:

carry_idle

carry_run

carry_jump

carry_fall

No exceptions.

---

# REQUIRED SWORD MAPPING

Gameplay Sword States must map to:

sword_idle

sword_run

sword_jump

sword_fall

No exceptions.

---

# REQUIRED ATTACK MAPPING

Directional Attack States must map to:

attack_right

attack_left

attack_up

attack_down

No fallback attacks permitted.

---

# TECHNICAL VALIDATION

Execute:

npm install

npm run build

npm test

---

# FAILURE CONDITIONS

Any failed test.

Any compilation failure.

Any runtime exception.

Immediate rollback.

---

# STATE MACHINE VALIDATION

Verify:

All transitions exist.

All transitions terminate correctly.

No dead-end states.

No state lock conditions.

No transition loops.

---

# INVALID STATES

The system must never allow:

CARRY + ATTACK

CARRY + SWORD

ATTACK + CARRY

Multiple active locomotion states

State desynchronization

---

# GAMEPLAY TESTS

Launch production build.

Verify:

movement

collection

transport

combat

persistence

---

# CARRY GAMEPLAY TEST

Perform:

pick object

walk

jump

fall

deposit object

---

Questions:

Does animation stay active?

Does object stay aligned?

Does same character remain visible?

---

# SWORD GAMEPLAY TEST

Perform:

equip sword

walk

jump

fall

idle

---

Questions:

Does animation stay active?

Does sword remain attached?

Does identity remain intact?

---

# ATTACK GAMEPLAY TEST

Perform:

attack right

attack left

attack up

attack down

---

Questions:

Is attack readable?

Is attack responsive?

Does player return to sword state?

---

# SAVE TESTS

Create saves while:

NORMAL

CARRY

SWORD

---

Reload.

Verify state restoration.

---

# RESTORE TESTS

Execute:

save

restore

reload

for every supported state.

---

# SCREENSHOT DELIVERABLES

Generate:

normal-idle.png

normal-run.png

carry-run.png

carry-jump.png

sword-run.png

sword-jump.png

attack-right.png

attack-left.png

attack-up.png

attack-down.png

---

# REQUIRED REPORTS

Generate:

integration-report.md

integration-report.json

state-machine-audit.md

---

# FEW SHOT 01

CORRECT

pick object

↓

carry state activates

↓

carry animation active

↓

object supported

APPROVE

---

# FEW SHOT 02

INCORRECT

pick object

↓

static placeholder appears

REJECT

---

# FEW SHOT 03

CORRECT

equip sword

↓

sword animations active

↓

identity preserved

APPROVE

---

# FEW SHOT 04

INCORRECT

equip sword

↓

character freezes

REJECT

---

# FEW SHOT 05

CORRECT

attack input

↓

directional attack

↓

return to sword state

↓

state remains stable

APPROVE

---

# ROLLBACK RULE

Rollback immediately if:

- visual regression
- gameplay regression
- persistence regression
- state machine regression
- save regression
- combat regression
- build regression
- test regression

---

# APPROVAL CHECKLIST

Carry Integrated:

PASS / FAIL

Sword Integrated:

PASS / FAIL

Attack Integrated:

PASS / FAIL

State Machine Stable:

PASS / FAIL

Build Successful:

PASS / FAIL

Tests Successful:

PASS / FAIL

Save/Restore Valid:

PASS / FAIL

Visual Consistency Preserved:

PASS / FAIL

---

# FINAL DECISION

APPROVE

Only if ALL sections PASS.

---

# END GOAL

The game now uses fully animated character states.

No static carry state exists.

No static sword state exists.

No placeholder attacks exist.

The official atlas has been expanded successfully through integration.
